en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a railway station building labeled 'STATION D'ISMAILIA'. The structure has three stories with arched ground-floor entrances and shuttered windows above. In front of the station stand several people in early 20th‑century attire, along with a horse‑drawn carriage to the right. The lower margin of the postcard bears a printed caption identifying the place and an attribution.
